title: VCAP Escrow Settlement
description: The final state of an escrow after verification. Represents either a release (payment to provider) or a refund (payment back to requester).

message_type.description: Discriminator for the VCAP message type.

negotiation_id.description: The negotiation_id this settlement is for.

status.description: Settlement outcome. RELEASED means funds went to the provider; REFUNDED means funds returned to the requester.

verification_id.description: The verification_id of the verification_callback that triggered this settlement.

proof_hash.description: Copied from the verification_callback.proof_hash for audit trail binding.

proof_signature.description: Copied from the verification_callback.proof_signature for audit trail binding.

evidence.description: Cryptographic evidence bundle stored with the settlement record for post-hoc auditability.

conduit_verification_id.description: OPTIONAL identifier from the Conduit browser automation session that performed the verification.

proof_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical proof bundle.

proof_signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex digest of the proof body signed with the shared secret.

extracted_content.description: OPTIONAL truncated content extracted during verification.

action_log.description: OPTIONAL full action log from the verification_callback for archival purposes.

platform_fee.description: OPTIONAL platform fee applied at settlement time.

amount.description: Absolute fee amount in decimal currency units.

rate.description: Fee rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 for 5%).

settled_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the escrow was settled.
